summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 interim financial report and related XBRL exhibits (period ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-09-30). In-prose, this is the equivalent of a US domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q. The filing references ordinary financing mechanics — Series A/Series B warrants, placement agent warrants tied to H.C. Wainwright, and certain Rodman & Renshaw contingent pre-funded warrants dated 2026-09-24 — but no merger, tender, activist, or going-private event. What to watch: any future 6-K disclosing substantive corporate action rather than periodic financial reporting.
